I have resolved the proxy authentication issue in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/utils.py#L960-L986).

### Cause
When [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) was updated to use `urllib3.util.parse_url` instead of `urlparse`, `parsed.netloc` only included `host` and `port` without `auth`. Consequently, when [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/adapters.py#L293-L318) called `prepend_scheme_if_needed(proxy, 'http')`, any authentication credentials in the proxy URL were stripped before [`proxy_manager_for`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/adapters.py#L167-L202) and [`proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted them.

### Solution
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fb0ailmu/requests/utils.py) to prepend `auth` (when present) back onto `netloc` before reconstructing the URL with `urlunparse`.
